newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Islamic summit opens in Pakistan.
newsitem.headline: Islamic summit opens in Pakistan.

text.p: Pakistani Prime Minister Nawaz Sharif opened a special summit of the Organisation of Islamic Conference (OIC) in Islamabad on Sunday.
The extraordinary conference of the 54-member OIC was called to honour Pakistan in its golden jubilee year, celebrating its 50th anniversary of independence in 1947.
Islamic leaders earlier watched a military parade along the capital's main avenue, named after the nation's founder Mohammad Ali Jinnah.

Iranian President Akbar Hashemi Rafsanjani, Turkish President Suleyman Demirel and Palestinian President Yasser Arafat were among the most prominent leaders at the summit, but many Arab heads of state stayed away.
